title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
quote: our method is not helpful for configurations where additional computation resources are not available
proves: Sections 3 and 6 distinguish the latency model's spare compute from the sampling guarantee.
does_not_prove: Does not price grammar masking or predict gains at load.

title: Accelerating Large Language Model Decoding with Speculative Sampling
quote: We run the tasks at batch size 1 with SpS and ArS.
proves: Pages 6–8 compare two tasks at batch 1 and warn that longer draft windows can increase latency variance.
does_not_prove: Does not establish the optimal draft width at mixed serving load.

title: Recurrent Drafter for Fast Speculative Decoding in Large Language Models
quote: enhancing draft model training through more advanced distillation techniques
proves: Section 5 calls out further distillation and implementation efficiency, after a real batch-size/beam-width sweep in Section 4.3.
does_not_prove: Does not identify a new general-purpose drafting primitive.
bearing: Threatens generic tree compression and claims that Apple only considered batch 1.

title: Speculative Decoding with a Speculative Vocabulary
quote: the benchmark remains limited to West Germanic languages
proves: The authors vary the draft vocabulary at every decode step. Limitations explicitly names languages outside the Indo-European family as future work.
does_not_prove: Does not isolate vocabulary misses among grammar choice points in tool outputs.

title: LLM-42: Enabling Determinism in LLM Inference with Verified Speculation
quote: Our implementation also does not currently integrate with speculative decoding-based LLM inference.
proves: End of Section 5 names missing prefix sharing and ordinary draft-model integration in its fixed-shape verify/rollback implementation.
does_not_prove: Does not show that all deterministic inference precludes prefix sharing.
bearing: Supports distinguishing reference numerics from equality in distribution.

title: FactorSpec: Serving Exact Relational Constraints as Speculative Drafts
quote: drafts every token the constraint determines as certain
proves: Sections 3, 5 and 6 implement relational forced-token drafting, compare tuned drafters and evaluate free-text dilution and BFCL.
does_not_prove: Does not attribute the remaining first rejections to target tokens outside a draft vocabulary.
bearing: Threatens recovering forced tokens as the contribution.

title: [Spec Decode] Compose grammar-constrained sampling with EAGLE speculative decoding
proves: The issue author found no empty intersection between allowed tokens and draft vocabulary in a diagnostic run and evaluated an enum-heavy schema separately.
does_not_prove: Nonempty intersection does not establish that the target-chosen valid token was present. Issue prototype is not release evidence.
bearing: Strong negative evidence on the simplest explanation.

title: Combining Guided Decoding and Speculative Decoding: Making CPU and GPU Cooperate Seamlessly
quote: These extra overheads could partially offset the benefits from the improved acceptance.
proves: Draft Model and Performance and Analysis explain draft/target vocab mapping and cost of masking during drafting.
does_not_prove: Does not isolate vocabulary coverage from the cost of grammar state or mask kernels.
bearing: Threatens simple masking and acceptance-only metrics.

title: SpecVocab
quote: EAGLE-3 draft model with the LM head tied to the target model
proves: Documents reduced, tied full-vocabulary and dynamic-vocabulary configurations including Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, training and benchmarking.
does_not_prove: Configurations alone do not guarantee a downloadable checkpoint or grammar compatibility.

title: Deterministic Inference
quote: fully deterministic inference while maintaining compatibility with chunked prefill, CUDA graphs, radix cache, and non-greedy sampling
proves: Supported Backends marks radix cache compatible for FA3 and Triton, and incompatible for FlashInfer on this path.
does_not_prove: Does not establish selective verify/rollback with shared generated prefixes.

title: NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM Now Supports Recurrent Drafting for Optimizing LLM Inference
quote: incorporate drafting and validation logic inside a single engine
proves: NVIDIA documents ReDrafter integration and inflight batching.
does_not_prove: Does not guarantee faster decode at every batch size.
bearing: Threatens a generic ReDrafter production integration project.
